description_en: Retrieves the recording lifecycle of IPC devices, which is the duration that recording files are stored in the cloud
description_zh: 调用该接口，获取IPC设备在云端保存录像文件的时间，即录像生命周期
name: QueryDeviceRecordLifeCycle

parameters.help_en:
The list of IotId values for IPC devices. An IotId is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html operation of IoT Platform to query this value
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的IotId列表。IotId是物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。

可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询
parameters.name: device_list

Code.description_en:
The response code. Valid values:

200: Success.
Other values: Error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

Day.description_en: The recording lifecycle of the IPC device

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
